title: User
description: Primary user account record for Customers, Workers, Businesses, and Admins in Mazdoor Sytu. Note: Financial balance is maintained exclusively in the wallets/{userId} collection.

id.description: Unique user ID (e.g. USR-101, WRK-201, BIZ-301)

phone.description: Primary 10-digit Indian mobile number with optional country code

name.description: Full name of the user or company representative

role.description: Role determining permissions and access tier

avatarUrl.description: Profile picture URL stored in Firebase Storage
